definition: sum over monitored layers of (layer_norm[step] / trailing median of that layer), warm-up excluded
fitted_on: development corpus, seeds 7000-7005, 48 real training runs (tests/experiments/gradient_boundary.py)

trimmed_l2.note: separates only at x4.0; rejected in favour of l1_aggregate

global_norm_ratio.note: INVERTED below x2.0; rejected as a primary criterion

chosen_boundaries_reasoning: A is set just above the maximum l1_aggregate observed across BOTH healthy classes (33.32, from a stable healthy run), so no healthy run reaches CONFIRMED. B is set at 46.0, which is above fault x4.0's minimum (46.18 is marginal; B=46.0 sits at the observed boundary) so x4.0 confirms reliably while x3.0 falls largely in UNCERTAIN. A and B are deliberately conservative: A uses the empirical maximum rather than a quantile, because with 12 healthy observations a quantile would be an artefact.

minimum_reliably_detectable_magnitude.x3.0: largely UNCERTAIN, development recall ~0.25 at B=46.0
minimum_reliably_detectable_magnitude.x2.5_and_below: insufficient evidence by design -- the classes overlap
minimum_reliably_detectable_magnitude.status: development measurement; NOT VALIDATED on a blind holdout
